cobblemon.ability.anotherlife.desc: The Pokémon can revive itself one time after it switches out, bringing it to half of its max HP and giving it the sleep condition.
cobblemon.battle.activate.anotherlife: %1$s was knocked out, but came back!
cobblemon.ability.derivative.desc: When it enters a battle, it copies an opposing Pokémon's stat changes.
cobblemon.ability.fury.desc: The Pokémon's anger boosts its Attack and Sp. Attack stats every time it flinches.
cobblemon.ability.psychout.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it psyches out opposing Pokémon and discourages them, lowering their Sp. Attack stats.
cobblemon.ability.restful.desc: While asleep, the Pokémon regains 1/8th of their HP at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.ability.slowmind.desc: For five turns, the Pokémon's Sp. Attack and Speed stats are halved.
cobblemon.ability.startle.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it startles opposing Pokémon and makes them hesitate, lowering their Defense stats.
cobblemon.ability.stupefy.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it stupefies opposing Pokémon and leaves them dumbfounded, lowering their Sp. Defense stats.
cobblemon.ability.terrify.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it terrifies opposing Pokémon and leaves them petrified, lowering their Speed stats.
cobblemon.ability.thickskin.desc: Reduces the power of non-supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon by 1/4th.
cobblemon.species.meowl.name: Meowl
cobblemon.species.meowl.desc: Meowl is a new soul that has come to this strange world in hopes of learning how to give and take.
cobblemon.species.missingno.name: MissingNo.
cobblemon.species.bunger.name: Bunger
cobblemon.species.bunger.desc1: This Pokémon loves to run into other Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.bunger.desc2: They can be easily distracted with ketchup.
